blocks.body: The International Court of Justice rules 9-6 that Myanmar violated the 1948 Genocide Convention in its 2016-17 campaign against the Rohingya - the first state ever held liable for genocide.
blocks.headline: WORLD COURT FINDS MYANMAR GUILTY OF GENOCIDE

blocks.body: Mogadishu orders the Emirati ambassador out within 72 hours and recalls its own envoy, accusing Abu Dhabi of backing breakaway regions.
blocks.headline: SOMALIA EXPELS UAE ENVOY IN 72 HOURS

blocks.body: A missile and drone barrage hits the Austrian and Dutch missions in Kyiv; European states summon Russian envoys in protest over the Vienna Convention breach.
blocks.headline: RUSSIAN STRIKES DAMAGE KYIV EMBASSIES

blocks.body: The Dow falls 2.19% to 49,097, the S&P 500 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25% as the AI rally reverses the day after Anthropic's debut.
blocks.headline: DOW SINKS BELOW 50,000 IN SIXTH STRAIGHT LOSS

blocks.body: Defence Minister Katz says forces will stay in buffer zones in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria, as a 24-hour raid in central Gaza ends.
blocks.headline: ISRAEL TO HOLD BUFFER ZONES INDEFINITELY

blocks.body: The revised Antalya text strips out phase-out language; island states threaten to block consensus as the final plenary meets today.
blocks.headline: COP31 DRAFT DROPS FOSSIL-FUEL PHASE-OUT

blocks.body: Shares in the Claude maker opened at $111.50 on a record $81.3bn IPO, then faded; AMD fell 7.7% and Nvidia 3.3%.
blocks.headline: ANTHROPIC ENDS DEBUT AT $97.17, UP 17%

blocks.body: Kyiv says Ruta missiles disrupted rail traffic across the bridge to Crimea; Moscow vows a response.
blocks.headline: UKRAINE HITS CRIMEAN BRIDGE WITH MISSILES

blocks.body: China and Russia publish a four-point declaration after the first three-way meeting of the US, Chinese and Russian leaders in Shenzhen; it sets no arms-reduction targets.
blocks.headline: TRUMP CLOSES HISTORIC TRILATERAL IN SHENZHEN

blocks.body: An unbeaten century lifts New Zealand to 243 for five on day one in Wellington; the Test continues today.
blocks.headline: NICHOLLS' 113* STEADIES NZ AGAINST INDIA

blocks.body: Fiji declares a national state of disaster over severe drought and water shortages worsened by El Nino conditions.
blocks.headline: FIJI DECLARES DISASTER AS DROUGHT BITES

blocks.body: South Korea's Supreme Court overturns former prime minister Han Duck-soo's conviction in the case over the 2024 martial law declaration.
blocks.headline: SEOUL COURT CLEARS EX-PM HAN

footer: THE DAILY GLOBE  •  Friday 20 November 2026  •  Headlines checked against fresh reporting and written in our own words. Sources named with each story.
in_brief: COP31's final plenary meets in Antalya today to fight over a draft that dropped fossil-fuel phase-out language.
Japan's October core CPI, China's loan prime rates and a speech from the ECB's Lagarde are due today.
Anthropic's record $81.3bn share offering is scheduled to close today.
Today is World Children's Day, marked around the globe.

lead.deck: Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan crosses the Andhra Pradesh-Odisha coast around midday, with winds of 90-100 km/h gusting to 110 and a storm surge of up to a metre; more than 300,000 people were moved to shelters as trains stopped and schools shut.
lead.headline: CYCLONE AKVAN SLAMS INTO INDIA'S EAST COAST
lead.source: Source: India Met Dept., The Hindu

markets_note: US stocks, 19 Nov close; Dow falls a sixth straight day. Brent $92.33; gold $3,663.50; Bitcoin ~$62,800.
tagline: One day. Every continent. One page.
